default.title: Shopify order import reliability
default.summary: ClawPilot now accepts valid Shopify orders with blank optional line fields and no longer treats an absent sales-channel requested-delivery date as an import exception.
features: Shippable orders without a sales-channel requested-delivery date keep an explicit null date and can continue through review and promotion
Operators can still add a manual delivery date or versioned default SLA when the workflow needs one
fixes: Valid empty Shopify SKU, vendor, and variant-title values no longer fail a 60-day order-history import
Only a truly absent requested-delivery date is nonblocking; malformed nonempty provider evidence still requires attention
Normalizer revisions ensure refreshed Shopify and Faire candidates use the corrected delivery-date semantics
